page.overview:
Who is Adam Ware?

His work earned Adam the attention of Tony Stark, becoming one of the beneficiarires personally handpicked by the genius inventor for a grant. As one of the twelve recipients who best used the money, Ware was nominated for the first annual Tony Stark Award, which he ended up winning. Adam was invited to the award ceremony in Malibu, where Tony Stark personally handed him the award. The ceremony was interrupted by Madame Masque and A.I.M., who kidnapped Ware at the same time other A.I.M. cells abducted the other recipients. Madame Masque wanted to recreate the circumstances that led Tony Stark to invent the Iron Man Armor, to put a brilliant mind against the wall, in order to "create" the next Tony Stark. To this end, A.I.M.'s victims were placed in elborate escape rooms aboard the repurposed S.H.I.E.L.D. Helicarrier Gold that generated traumatizing scenarios.

Unlike the rest of the victims, Adam's priority wasn't in building weapons to escape; he instead tried to find ways to contact outside help. At one point he even hacked into into A.I.M.'s systems to check in on the rest of the captives. Iron Man eventually tracked down A.I.M., but was abducted as well. Adam managed to patch through to him, and they orchestrated an escape. Ware used his technology to remotelly-control the Iron Man to distract A.I.M., while Tony snuck around to free the survivors of A.I.M.'s ploy. When Adam reconvened with Stark and the captives, they were intercepted by Fixer—Madame Masque's right-hand man. Wearing an Advanced Iron Man Armor made out of the weapons created by the abductees, he grazed Adam with a laser beam, partially disfiguring him, and seemingly killing him. Stark and the survivors managed to escape from the plummeting Helicarrier, unwittingly leaving Adam to be retrieved by Madame Masque and Fixer. When they brought him as a prisoner to an audience with the High Council of A.I.M., Adam used his technology, now incorporated into his body, to hijack all of A.I.M.'s systems and claim ownership of the organization, killing Fixer in the process.
